queries.negative_balance: SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE balance_minor<0 OR reserved_minor<0 OR reserved_minor>balance_minor
queries.balance_conservation: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT u.id FROM users u LEFT JOIN ledger l ON l.user_id=u.id GROUP BY u.id,u.balance_minor HAVING u.balance_minor+coalesce(sum(l.amount_minor),0)<>1000000) t
queries.reservation_conservation: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT u.id FROM users u LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.user_id=u.id AND p.status='PENDING' GROUP BY u.id,u.reserved_minor HAVING u.reserved_minor<>coalesce(sum(p.amount_minor),0)) t
queries.agency_balance: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT a.id FROM agencies a LEFT JOIN settlements s ON s.agency_id=a.id GROUP BY a.id,a.settlement_balance_minor HAVING a.settlement_balance_minor<>coalesce(sum(s.net_amount),0)) t
queries.orphan_user: SELECT count(*) FROM payments p LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=p.user_id WHERE u.id IS NULL
queries.orphan_agency: SELECT count(*) FROM payments p LEFT JOIN agencies a ON a.id=p.agency_id WHERE a.id IS NULL
